question: Which Jain text is recognised in the West and known for its verses on monk conduct, sermons, and poetic teachings?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Acaranga Sutra**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The **Acaranga Sutra** is one of the oldest and most revered texts in Jainism.
 
• This sacred text primarily deals with **the conduct and discipline of Jain monks** and provides guidelines on leading an ascetic life.
 
• Written in the ancient Prakrit language, it is associated with the **Shvetambara Jain tradition**.
 
• The text emphasizes non-violence (Ahimsa) and self-restraint as the fundamental principles of Jainism.
 
• The Acaranga Sutra is also recognized for its poetic teachings and sermons, offering profound insights into spiritual and ethical living, which has garnered attention in the West.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Uttaradhyayana Sutra**

 
 
• The Uttaradhyayana Sutra is another significant Jain scripture, which contains teachings and stories aimed at guiding Jain monks and laypeople toward spiritual enlightenment.
 
• This text is presented in the form of dialogues and narratives, offering practical advice on moral conduct and religious principles.
 
• It is considered an important text for both Shvetambara and Digambara sects.
 
 
 
• **Kalpa Sutra**
 
 
• The Kalpa Sutra is a key text in Jainism, particularly for the Shvetambara sect, and is read during the holy festival of Paryushana.
 
• It includes biographies of the 24 Tirthankaras, including Lord Mahavira, along with rules for monastic conduct.
 
• The text also discusses the Jain monastic calendar and rituals.
 
 
 
• **Bhagavati Sutra**
 
 
• The Bhagavati Sutra, also known as Vyakhyaprajnapti, is an encyclopedic Jain text that forms part of the Shvetambara Jain canon.
 
• It consists of dialogues between Lord Mahavira and his disciples, covering a variety of topics such as cosmology, philosophy, and ethics.
 
• It is an important resource for understanding Jain metaphysics and doctrinal concepts.
